scope: Proposition 6.4 of the manuscript “Slope-field perturbations of the two-cylinder covering” (preprints/Slope-field-perturbations-of-the-two-cylinder-covering-September-27-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 100 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6e6336ef3860f900), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The tetrahedron K2 admits a finite cylinder cover with compact convex parallelogram perpendicular bases whose total area is less than 1 2 min|u|=1 |πu⊥ K2|.
